description:
Ethereum and Base JSON-RPC on our own archive nodes. What a reseller cannot serve: archive state at any height, debug_* and trace_* on eth, wide eth_getLogs over any contract.
base: reth v2.5.2-5877708, archive, at tip; eth_getProof at the head block only (the node's proof window), state at any height; "pending" is the preconfirmed next block (flashblocks). eth: reth v2.2.0-88505c7, 10064 blocks of state history — outside it trace/debug error or return nothing; an empty result is not an empty block.
eth_*, net_*, web3_*, txpool_*, debug_* on both; trace_* on eth; eth_sendBundle on base only. admin_, personal_, miner_, engine_ refused. Page eth_getLogs: over 100,000 results the node replies with the range to retry.
The full method list per chain is in /llms.txt.
Paid by the millisecond on a line, or one block per call without one. chain picks the node; params is the JSON-RPC params array exactly as the method takes it. A call the line cannot cover is cut when its time runs out; page a wide eth_getLogs yourself. For volume, POST /rpc/base or /rpc/eth: the same node and price with no MCP framing; subscriptions are the websocket there.
Example: {"chain":"base","method":"eth_blockNumber","params":[]}

chain.description: string — which node to forward to: eth or base

line.description: optional — a line credential: the call burns the line's time and carries no payment.

method.description: string — any method the node serves: eth_*, net_*, web3_*, txpool_*, debug_*, trace_*; admin_/personal_/miner_/engine_ refused.

name: call_rpc

anyOf.description: the node this was forwarded to

title: call_rpc
